fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Unique number assigned to the invoice.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Date on which the invoice was issued.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Final date by which the invoice must be paid.

fields.name: purchase_order_number
fields.description: Purchase order number provided by the customer.

fields.name: seller_name
fields.description: Legal name of the company issuing the invoice.

fields.name: seller_address
fields.description: Registered address of the company issuing the invoice.

fields.name: seller_gstin
fields.description: GST identification number of the seller.

fields.name: seller_email
fields.description: Billing or contact email address of the seller.

fields.name: seller_phone
fields.description: Contact phone number of the seller.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Name of the customer purchasing the products.

fields.name: customer_address
fields.description: Billing address of the customer.

fields.name: customer_gstin
fields.description: GST identification number of the customer.

fields.name: place_of_supply
fields.description: State or location where the products are supplied.

fields.name: item_description
fields.description: Item or product description for this line, including its SKU if shown.

fields.name: item_hsn
fields.description: HSN/SAC classification code for this line item.

fields.name: item_quantity
fields.description: Quantity billed on this line.

fields.name: item_unit
fields.description: Unit of measure for this line, e.g. Nos, Set, Hrs.

fields.name: item_rate
fields.description: Price per unit for this line, before tax.

fields.name: item_amount
fields.description: Line total: quantity x rate, before tax.

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Total value of all items before taxes and adjustments.

fields.name: discount_total
fields.description: Total discount applied to the invoice.

fields.name: cgst_rate
fields.description: Central GST percentage applied to the invoice.

fields.name: cgst_amount
fields.description: Central GST amount charged on the invoice.

fields.name: sgst_rate
fields.description: State GST percentage applied to the invoice.

fields.name: sgst_amount
fields.description: State GST amount charged on the invoice.

fields.name: igst_rate
fields.description: Integrated GST percentage applied to an interstate invoice.

fields.name: igst_amount
fields.description: Integrated GST amount charged on the invoice.

fields.name: total_tax
fields.description: Combined tax amount charged on the invoice.

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Final invoice amount including taxes and adjustments.

fields.name: amount_paid
fields.description: Amount already paid by the customer.

fields.name: balance_due
fields.description: Remaining amount to be paid by the customer.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency used for all monetary values in the invoice.

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Conditions defining when payment is expected.

fields.name: payment_status
fields.description: Current payment state, such as unpaid, partially paid, paid or overdue.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional instructions or information related to the invoice.
